lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Circular high-luminance pixel clusters are arranged in distinct vertical columns posterior to the fifth gill slit. The columns exhibit a semi-regular spacing with approximately 4 to 6 spots per column in the visible lateral field.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the centroids of the circular blobs, forming a discernible grid-like lattice across the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and a shadow-induced low-intensity gradient on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A highly reflective, elongated horizontal feature (potential remora or attachment) is visible on the lower ventral flank below the gill region.
